name: Japan
gaps: The Wild Bird Society of Japan has roughly 85 prefectural and city chapters; this list covers a representative spread across all seven WBSJ regional blocks rather than every single branch.

groups.name: Wild Bird Society of Japan
groups.blurb: Japan's BirdLife partner and national bird society, with prefectural branches nationwide running walks and counts.

groups.name: WBSJ Sapporo Chapter
groups.blurb: Sapporo branch of the national bird society, running local outings and surveys around the city.

groups.name: WBSJ Chiba Chapter

groups.blurb: Saitama prefecture branch organizing regular birdwatching outings and counts.

name: Taiwan
gaps: Yilan and Pingtung counties have registered bird societies affiliated with the national federation, but no live website or verifiable social page of their own could be found for either.

groups.name: Taiwan Wild Bird Federation
groups.blurb: National federation of Taiwan's city and county bird societies, coordinating conservation and birdwatching.

groups.name: Taipei Wild Bird Society
groups.blurb: Taipei's bird society since 1973, running walks, research and conservation work across the city.

groups.name: Taoyuan Wild Bird Society
groups.blurb: Taoyuan city bird society running local birdwatching outings and counts.

groups.name: Hsinchu Wild Bird Society
groups.blurb: Hsinchu city bird society known for its long running survey of Xiangshan Wetland, with regular outings.

groups.name: Taiwan Wild Bird Association
groups.blurb: Taichung based bird association running birdwatching walks, rescue work and education.

groups.name: Chiayi City Wild Bird Society
groups.blurb: Chiayi city bird society running local birdwatching outings and habitat surveys.

groups.name: Tainan Wild Bird Society
groups.blurb: Tainan city bird society organizing birdwatching walks and wetland counts.

groups.name: Kaohsiung Wild Bird Society
groups.blurb: Kaohsiung's bird society since 1979, the south's oldest ecology group, running walks and research.

groups.name: Changhua Wild Bird Society
groups.blurb: Changhua county bird society, known for its annual grey faced buzzard watch each spring.

groups.name: Hualien Wild Bird Society
groups.blurb: Hualien county bird society on Taiwan's east coast, running birdwatching outings and counts.

name: South Korea
gaps: No regional or city level birding clubs with their own live websites could be verified; South Korean birding activity concentrates in a small number of national bodies and platforms rather than a local club network.

groups.name: Birds Korea
groups.blurb: Conservation group researching and protecting birds and habitats across Korea and the Yellow Sea.

groups.name: Korean Birding Association
groups.blurb: Nationwide birding culture association running birdwatching festivals and community events.

groups.name: Korea Wild Bird Association
groups.blurb: National wild bird protection association promoting conservation and birdwatching.

groups.name: Bird Research Center, Korea National Park Service
groups.blurb: Research center studying migratory birds at Heuksan, Taean and Geoje with public survey work.

groups.name: Nationwide Bird Watching
groups.blurb: Countrywide citizen science project for logging bird sightings on Korea's Naturing platform.

name: China
gaps: Beijing: the volunteer Friends of Nature Bird Watching Group is active with regular outings, but has no landing page separate from its parent NGO's site.
Shanghai: Shanghai Wild Bird Society (shwbs.org) is a real registered group, but its server did not respond from outside China during verification, so its link is left out rather than forced in.
Guangzhou: Yangguang Bird Watching Protection Association is a real registered group with no findable website of its own.
Chengdu: Chengdu Birdwatching Society is active and well known locally but has no findable website of its own.

Wuhan, Nanjing, Hangzhou, Qingdao, Fuzhou, Tianjin, Dalian, Chongqing and Kunming all have active local birdwatching groups, but no live, independently verifiable website could be confirmed for any of them; several candidate domains (zjbird.cn, jsbws.org, cqbws.org) were dead, unreachable or served a placeholder page during verification.

groups.name: China Bird Report Center
groups.blurb: The Zhuque Society's national bird sighting record platform, coordinating China's birdwatching groups and citizen science.

groups.name: Shenzhen Bird Watching Society
groups.blurb: China's first registered city bird society, running surveys and education work in Shenzhen since 2004.

groups.name: Xiamen Bird Watching Society
groups.blurb: Volunteer bird society in Xiamen since 2002, running outings, courses and bird surveys.

groups.name: Changzhou Wild Bird Society
groups.blurb: Volunteer bird group focused on birdwatching activities and outings around Changzhou.

groups.name: Hong Kong Bird Watching Society
groups.blurb: Hong Kong's BirdLife partner since 1957, running walks, surveys and the citizen science Sparrow Census.

groups.name: Hong Kong Wild Bird Conservation Concern Group
groups.blurb: Facebook community campaigning for wild bird habitat and living space across Hong Kong.

name: Macau
gaps: No dedicated wild bird watching community could be found for Macau; the only active bird related group found was a pet parrot and cage bird Facebook group, which falls outside this project's scope.

name: Mongolia
gaps: The historic Mongolian Ornithological Society (founded 1999) has no live website; its old domain mos.mn now serves an unrelated gambling site, and no current independent website or verifiable social page could be found for it.

groups.name: Wildlife Science and Conservation Center of Mongolia
groups.blurb: Mongolia's BirdLife partner, running bird ringing stations and satellite tracking of migratory birds.

name: North Korea
gaps: No birdwatching society, club or public group could be found for North Korea; birding in the DPRK is organized entirely through foreign tour operators visiting sites like the Mundok Migratory Bird Reserve, not a local community.
